name: hud_sensor_tracker_init
description: HudSensorTracker::Init resets map runtime state, applies optional bounds, clears tracked save-state selection, and restores the default save-state marker distance.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The plan keeps Reconstructed as limited because Binary Ninja still renders the 0.7f immediate store to mapZoom as a strncpy artifact even though assembly and source agree on the stored value.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x416660 resets map state fields, stores mapFileVersion 5 and mapZoom 0.7f, calls SetBounds(outerRectOrNull, nullptr), clears tracked save-state selection, clears map world/sound pointers, and calls SetSaveStateMarkerMaxDistance(450.0f).
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x416660 has no warnings or tags; the known artifact is the 0.7f immediate rendered as strncpy.
The native hud_sensor_map_bounds_and_save_state_smoke calls Init with an outer rect and verifies the reset map state, mapZoom, and 450.0 squared save-state marker distance.
